meta.purpose: Governed institutional translation memory for es-419. This is the curated, auditable asset (Translation Memory + neutral glossary + neutralization rules) plus the applied locale config that drives high-quality, neutral output. It is NOT machine-translation output and NOT the offline demo fixtures.

lifecycle_legend.active: Approved and in force — APPLIED by the pipeline.
lifecycle_legend.approved: Approved — APPLIED by the pipeline (treated equivalently to active).
lifecycle_legend.proposed: Submitted to the governance queue, awaiting approver/admin decision — NOT applied.
lifecycle_legend.candidate: Auto-suggested, not yet reviewed — NOT applied.
lifecycle_legend.deprecated: Retired by an admin — NOT applied (kept for audit history).

meta.governance_contract: Only entries with state 'active' or 'approved' are applied by the pipeline (src/memory/apply.ts). Entries under any `governance_queue` are NOT applied; do not fold them into a live system without approver/admin sign-off (ADR 0008). Logs are append-only; corrections are compensating events, never mutations.

translation_memory.target_text: Approved target-language segment — this is the reusable asset.
translation_memory.locale: Target locale this pair belongs to.
translation_memory.kind: Segment class. 'disclaimer' = compliance boilerplate, routed separately and EXCLUDED from RAG few-shot retrieval.
translation_memory.version: Monotonic version; superseded versions are replaced by a higher version (none superseded in this export).
translation_memory.approved_by: User id of the approver/admin who signed this pair off.
translation_memory.created_at: ISO timestamp the pair was created.

glossary.forbidden_terms: Renderings that must NOT be used for this term (validator-enforced).
glossary.notes: Reviewer guidance for applying the term.

neutralization_rules.variant: Source variant the regional_form belongs to (e.g. es-ES, es-MX).
neutralization_rules.hits: Count of times the rule has fired across processed documents.

glossary.description: Approved term mappings (source→approved_target) with forbidden_terms. Applied when state is active|approved.

applied.notes: Use plural 'rendimientos'. Avoid Peninsular 'curva de tipos'.
As an asset class, 'renta variable'. 'acciones' is acceptable for individual shares but not the asset class.
'fondo de cobertura' is the institutional standard for LatAm.
In a risk context, 'caída máxima'. Avoid 'retiro' (that is a withdrawal).
Bond duration is 'duración'. Do not confuse with 'plazo' (term/maturity).
LatAm standard 'tasa de interés'. Peninsular 'tipo de interés' is forbidden.
'recorte de tasas'. Peninsular 'bajada de tipos' forbidden.

neutralization_rules.description: Regional-form→neutral-form rewrite rules. Applied ONLY when state is active|approved; everything else is in the governance queue and must not be auto-applied.

applied.reason: Peninsular 'tipo de interés' is rendered 'tasa de interés' across Latin America.
In a corporate-profit sense the Peninsular 'beneficios' reads as employee benefits in LatAm; use 'utilidades'.
Peninsular 'cuota de mercado' is 'participación de mercado' in neutral LatAm usage.
Peninsular 'móvil' for a mobile phone is 'teléfono celular' (or 'celular') in LatAm.
Peninsular 'bajada de tipos' for a rate cut is 'recorte de tasas' in neutral LatAm.
Trim the redundant 'fijo'; neutral institutional usage is 'depósito a plazo'.

governance_queue.reason: Peninsular 'ordenador' for a computer is 'computadora' across Latin America.
Peninsular 'coche' for a car is 'automóvil' (or 'carro/auto') in neutral LatAm; 'automóvil' is the pan-regional choice.
Peninsular 'facturación' as top-line revenue is clearer as 'ingresos por ventas' for a pan-regional audience.

locale_config.description: Applied locale configuration from config/locales/<locale>.yml. This is CONFIG, not lifecycle-governed memory, but it materially drives quality: scale_terms (the billion=10^9 'mil millones' / 十亿 / 十億 trap), number format, register, regional_flags (validator input), morphology, and the language-specific prompt clauses.

config.name: Español neutro (Latinoamérica)
config.description: Pan-regional Spanish for cross-market distribution. No country-specific lexicon, no vosotros (use ustedes), formal institutional register. One deliverable, not N regional variants (spec §2).

prompts.translator_target:
NEUTRAL Latin-American Spanish (español neutro, es-419): pan-regional, no
country-specific lexicon, no vosotros (use ustedes). Formal, native, institutional register.
